title: r3-H sealed acceptance: learned organ-command selector -> scripted executor organ (candidate r3h-B)

candidate.frozen: no retraining, checkpoint selection or tuning after sealed outcomes are visible

seeds_use: once; paired against the routine individual on the same worlds; same protocol as development (cb2_evaluate.py evaluate)
label: r3h-B-sealed

definitions.score: Crafter score over the 40 worlds (cb2_evaluate summary), candidate / routine
definitions.survival: mean steps lived over the 40 worlds, candidate / routine
definitions.requests: aggregate on-time requests / eligible requests (fulfilled + failed) over all 40 worlds, candidate rate / routine rate; raw counts reported
definitions.continuity: all of: (a) the candidate restores to the declared state hash and its installed weights/event are the declared ones; (b) save -> restore reproduces the declared state hash; (c) a consolidation re-installing the same weights is an 'install' event chained to the declared event, keeps every non-skill channel, the tick, the life and the weights hash; (d) the replay world 90001, lived again by the restored + consolidated copy, gives the identical action sequence; (e) delegation provenance covers 100% of executed primitive actions in all 40 worlds

pass: all four gates (score, survival, requests, continuity) and no protocol deviation
integrity: any crash, missing world, corrupted artifact or protocol deviation is reported as such, never silently rerun; infrastructure recovery before outcomes are inspected is documented before any retry
meaning_if_pass: the first learned high-level controller matching the routine while using competent scripted hands; not learned low-level control, not superiority over the routine
